article.summary_es: La Academy of Medical & Public Health Services (AMPHS) aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn, en la 3rd Avenue. Abre los sábados de 2pm a 4pm.
article.summary_en: Academy of Medical & Public Health Services (AMPHS) is listed on the City's Food Help NYC map as a food pantry in Brooklyn, on 3rd Avenue. It is open Saturdays 2pm-4pm.
how_they_help_es: Aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad como despensa de alimentos.
Está en 5306 3rd Avenue, 2do piso, Brooklyn, NY 11220.
Abre los sábados de 2pm a 4pm; la despensa funciona el 1er y 3er sábado del mes.
Puede llamar al (212) 256-9036 para preguntar antes de ir.
how_they_help_en: Listed on the City's Food Help NYC map as a food pantry.
Located at 5306 3rd Avenue, 2nd Floor, Brooklyn, NY 11220.
Open Saturdays 2pm-4pm; the pantry runs on the 1st and 3rd Saturday of the month.
You can call (212) 256-9036 to ask questions before visiting.
visit_tips_es: La despensa funciona solo el 1er y 3er sábado del mes, de 2pm a 4pm.
La información fue verificada por última vez el 10 de octubre de 2026.
No se indica qué alimentos entrega ni si hay requisitos; llame al (212) 256-9036 para preguntar.
visit_tips_en: The pantry runs only on the 1st and 3rd Saturday of the month, 2pm-4pm.
This information was last checked on October 10, 2026.
What food is given and any requirements are not listed; call (212) 256-9036 to ask.
